label: FP
reason: Both alerts are false positives. Alert 1 (java/xss) is FP because encodeForHTML(sql) at lines 68-71 properly sanitizes the SQL string before HTML output. Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is FP because bar derives from param which comes from name (HTTP parameter NAME), not from user-supplied parameter VALUES. The SQL query uses bar as a parameter NAME lookup, not as injected user input into the SQL string.

evidence.note: encodeForHTML(sql) sanitizes the SQL string for XSS prevention
